title: Walt Disney Co General SEC Filings
source_summary: Recent DIS SEC filings converted into underwriting-oriented disclosure summaries.

fields.title: Walt Disney Co General SEC Filings
capital_markets_activity: Recent filings include debt issuance and financing-related 8-K disclosure.
capital_allocation_activity: Share Repurchase Program Effective February 7, 2024, the Board of Directors authorized the Company to repurchase a total of 400 million shares of its common stock.
See Note 10 to the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements for a summary of dividends and share repurchases.
liquidity_notes: Liquidity needs of the master trust are generally managed using cash generated by investments or by liquidating securities.
governance_notes: (d) On March 18, 2026, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of The Walt Disney Company (the “Company”) appointed Josh D’Amaro to serve (i) as a Director on the Board, effective immediately, with a term expiring at the 2027 annual meeting of shareholders, and (ii) on the Executive Committee of the Board.

Appointment of Chief Executive Officer and Senior Advisor On February 2, 2026, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of The Walt Disney Company (the “Company”) appointed Josh D’Amaro, currently the Chairman of Disney Experiences, as the Chief Executive Officer of the Company and appointed Robert A.
controls_and_risk_notes: Based on their evaluation as of December 27, 2025, the principal executive officer and principal financial officer of the Company have concluded that the Company’s disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934) are effective.

Changes in Internal Controls – There have been no changes in our internal control over financial reporting during the first quarter of fiscal 2026 that have materially affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect, our internal control over financial reporting.
Risk Factors For an enterprise as large and complex as the Company, a wide range of factors could materially affect future developments and performance.
analyst_relevance: Update debt, interest, and refinancing assumptions from disclosed financing activity.
Reflect buyback pace and remaining authorization in share count and capital allocation assumptions.
Use management liquidity commentary as a check on near-term funding and rating pressure.
Treat governance and control disclosures as qualitative checks rather than direct valuation drivers.
